layer_3_action.subject: Juvenile Allosaurus
features: prominent pointed lacrimal horn ridges rising directly above and in front of the eyes
laterally compressed hatchet-shaped deep skull with a cleanly closed jawline
strong proportional forelimbs featuring three distinct fingers with sharp claws
large, calm, intelligent eyes with a curious expression
smooth, matte clay-like skin with defined muscle anatomy and crisp contours
layer_3_action.action: A composed, non-aggressive juvenile Allosaurus with high-poly clay geometry is standing calmly behind the vertical trunk of a large Araucaria conifer tree, tilting its head slightly to look outward. The camera frames a clean three-quarter profile that highlights the distinctive pointed eyebrow horns and the athletic structure of its body without any infant-like or over-rounded proportions. Its expression is quiet and observant as it watches a small dragonfly hover near a cluster of low Jurassic-base ferns under soft, cinematic studio lighting. No text.
